item:
diff --git a/studio/content/docs/loop.mdx b/studio/content/docs/loop.mdx
@@ -40,2 +40,4 @@
 The checks run in two stages.
+Script checks run first, all at once, and bot checks only run when no blocking script failed.
+So if a blocking script fails, the bot checks do not run.
 Verdicts keep the order of the `checks` list.

diff --git a/studio/content/docs/sandbox.mdx b/studio/content/docs/sandbox.mdx
@@ -5,2 +5,4 @@
 Every run starts in a container.
+The hub is mounted read-only at `/hub`.
+Scripts cannot write to `/hub`, because the hub is mounted read-only there.
 Scripts read it as `$BOTHUB_HUB`.

diff --git a/studio/content/docs/loop.mdx b/studio/content/docs/loop.mdx
@@ -52,2 +52,4 @@
 `max` counts retries after the first attempt.
+A job that blocks on a question parks its work on its branch.
+Parking means the job keeps its work on its branch when it blocks on a question.
 The loop also stops on budget.

@@ -52,2 +52,4 @@
 `max` counts retries after the first attempt.
+A job that blocks on a question parks its work on its branch.
+The next run of that job on the same issue starts from the parked commit, with the question and its answer in the prompt.
 The loop also stops on budget.
